text:
Which statement explains why plastic bags made from poly(ethene) accumulate in oceans?
A
Poly(ethene) is a saturated molecule.
B
Poly(ethene) is made from hydrocarbon monomers.
C
Poly(ethene) reacts with water.
D
Poly(ethene) does not decompose in water.

options.label: B
options.text: Poly(ethene) is made from hydrocarbon monomers.

options.label: D
options.text: Poly(ethene) does not decompose in water.
